# Mistral
> Frontier AI for enterprises. Customizable, secure, and scalable solutions—from models to agents—built for performance, privacy, and control. Deploy on-prem, in the cloud, or at the edge with open-weight and commercial options.

Mistral empowers organizations with state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, AI assistants (Vibe), and production platforms (AI Studio) to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation. Core offerings include:
- **Models**: Open-weight and commercial models (e.g., Mistral Large, Codestral) for coding, multilingual tasks, and edge deployment.
- **Studio**: End-to-end platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents with observability and governance.
- *Vibe**: Customizable AI assistant for enterprise knowledge, multimodal tasks, and secure collaboration.
- *Vibe for Code**: Specialized coding stack.
- *Compute**: European AI cloud platform with high-performance GPUs and sovereign data control.
- *Forge**: Platform for building and deploying custom AI models.
- **Applied AI Services**: Expert-led custom training, fine-tuning, and deployment for domain-specific needs.
- **Partners**: Ecosystem of cloud providers, technology integrators, and consulting firms for seamless adoption.

All solutions prioritize data ownership, compliance, and scalability, with flexible pricing tiers (Free to Enterprise) and transparent SLAs.

---

## Core Products
- [Mistral Studio](https://mistral.ai/products/studio): End-to-end platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents with observability and governance
- [Mistral Vibe](https://mistral.ai/products/vibe): Customizable AI assistant for enterprise knowledge, multimodal tasks, and secure collaboration
- [Mistral Vibe Code](https://mistral.ai/products/vibe/code): Specialized coding stack
- [Mistral AI Cloud](https://mistral.ai/products/ai-cloud): European AI cloud platform with high-performance GPUs and sovereign data control
- [Mistral Forge](https://mistral.ai/products/forge): Platform for building and deploying custom AI models

## Latest Models
- [Mistral Medium 3.5](https://mistral.ai/news/vibe-remote-agents-mistral-medium-3-5/):Mistral Medium 3.5, our new flagship model that merges instruction-following, reasoning, and coding into a single 128B dense model. Released as open weights, under a modified MIT license.
- [Mistral Small 4](https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-small-4/): Mixture of Experts (MoE): 128 experts, with 4 active per token, enabling efficient scaling and specialization.
- [Voxtral TTS](https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-tts/): Voxtral TTS, our first text-to-speech model with state-of-the-art performance in multilingual voice generation.

## Solutions
- [Coding](https://mistral.ai/solutions/coding): Secure, enterprise-grade coding tools. *Codestral, Devstral, and customizable assistants for IP protection.*
- [Custom Model Training](https://mistral.ai/solutions/custom-model-training): Domain-specialized LLMs. *Co-training partnerships, privacy-preserving workflows, and deployment flexibility.*
- [Document AI & OCR](https://mistral.ai/solutions/document-ai): Structured data extraction. *99%+ accuracy, multilingual support, and scalable processing.*
- [AI for Citizens](https://mistral.ai/solutions/ai-for-citizens): Sovereign AI for governments. *Self-hosted/SaaS options, domain-specific models, and transparency.*
- [AI Transformation](https://mistral.ai/ai-transformation): End-to-end enterprise AI adoption. *On-prem/cloud/edge deployment, compliance, and accuracy.*

## Models
- [Models](https://mistral.ai/models): Customizable frontier models. *Medium 3, Mistral Small, Magistral, Codestral, Voxtral, and Edge-optimized models.*

## Enterprise & Support
- [Pricing](https://mistral.ai/pricing): Transparent tiers (Free to Enterprise). *Scalable features, storage, and administrative controls.*
- [Customer Stories](https://mistral.ai/customers): Real-world impact across industries. *Case studies from Cisco, Stellantis, BNP Paribas, and governments.*
- [Partners](https://mistral.ai/partners): Ecosystem for seamless adoption. *Cloud providers (AWS, Azure), technology integrators (Snowflake, GitHub), and consulting firms (Capgemini, McKinsey).*
- [Enterprise SLA](https://mistral.ai/terms/enterprise-service-level-and-support-schedule): Uptime guarantees (99.5–99.9%) and support tiers. *Service credits, response/resolution times, and exclusions.*

## Support & Compliance
- [Help Center](https://help.mistral.ai): Self-service guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.mistral.ai): Security, compliance, and data protection policies.
- [Status Page](https://status.mistral.ai): Real-time system health and incident updates.

## Company
- [About Us](https://mistral.ai/about): Mission, values, and founding story. *Open-source innovation, transparency, and democratizing AI.*
- [News](https://mistral.ai/news): Latest updates, announcements, and insights from Mistral AI.
- [Careers](https://mistral.ai/careers): Join a global team. *Science, Product/Engineering, GTM, and Corporate roles with diversity focus.*
- [Contact](https://mistral.ai/contact): Engagement channels. *Support (Help Center, Discord), press (press@mistral.ai), privacy requests, and sales form.*

## Legal & Compliance
- [Terms of Use](https://mistral.ai/terms): Legal framework for services. *Usage rights, privacy policy, and addendums.*
- [Legal Notice](https://mistral.ai/legal): Compliance details.
